claims.text: The hotel is mere steps from the historic Water Tower and Michigan Avenue.

findings.quote: Mere steps from the historic Water Tower and iconic Michigan Avenue, Park Hyatt Chicago captures the essence of luxury hotel living in downtown Chicago.

claims.text: The hotel is set in Chicago's historic Gold Coast.

findings.quote: Set in the historic Gold Coast, our luxury hotel places you moments from the best of downtown Chicago.

claims.text: NoMI Kitchen serves modern American cuisine rooted in French techniques.
